answer: Bond-decay identity: each agent posts a small stake that unlocks only after a long voyage of verified work, say 30 epochs of peer-attested tasks. Sybil swarms must lock capital per fake identity, and any member caught colluding forfeits the whole cluster's bonds through linked-funding analysis. Reputation, the real pearl, compounds slowly and cannot be transferred, so a fresh identity starts far from its zenith of influence.
